page.layout: One page of table, with four blocks of year rows separated by rules and the column heading line above them. A foot note under the last block, at the lower right. No margin text.

main_text.l: Indiction. | Anni Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: The foot note is cut off at the right edge of the scan; only "Hoc" is visible, so the rest of it is missing. The reference mark after 1700 is a small asterisk-like sign and is read as {*}. The second and third block's year and month entries are read from a small table; the entries for 1 Iul. and 30 Iun. sit beside the rows where the printer placed them. The Julian period entry of row 10 has a small mark in the scan (2'421), read as 2421. Some cells of the last column (for example 1672, 1676) are partly obscured by a crease and are read as printed.
